# Extra Folder

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The top-level `x` folder space in Obsidian includes Extra or Support resources.

**Also known as:** Support Folder

## Scope note

- This includes infrastructure like.templates (using Obsidian Templater plugin), images, documents, scripts, etc.
- It does not include knowledge content itself.

## Broader

- [Vault](../Vault/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
